clauses.reason: The order opens the stated Form 990-A returns to inspection by the special committee until and including January 3, 1955. That wording includes the day itself, so the first end is the close of January 3, 1955. It is the order's own stated date; no held instrument amends, extends, revokes or shortens it, and the effective-on-filing sentence only starts the order.

research_rationale:
EO 10518 (signed 1954-02-11 by Dwight D. Eisenhower; filed 1954-02-12, 11:13 a.m.; 19 FR 851, Federal Register of February 13, 1954 per the held source record) is read in full from the registered text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10518.txt; its number, title and date agree with the census register. Inventory: one operative paragraph. Under section 55(a) of the Internal Revenue Code it orders that any return on Form 990-A made by an organization exempt under section 101(6) of the Code, for the years 1950 to 1953 inclusive, be open to inspection until and including January 3, 1955 by the special committee of the House of Representatives authorized by House Resolution 217, 83d Congress, agreed to July 27, 1953, to investigate tax-exempt foundations, for carrying out that resolution and subject to the Treasury decision on inspection of returns by committees of Congress approved the same day; the order takes effect on filing for publication. First end: the stated date. The words until and including make the day itself part of the period, so the end is recorded as January 3, 1955 and the exclusive reading (ending when that day begins) is not open on this text. The order does not tie its end to the life of the committee; the text of House Resolution 217 is not held, so any earlier lapse of the committee's own authority is not shown and would not change the order's stated end. Later instruments: a scan of every held order text for the bare number 10518 found only unrelated page numbers in other documents; no held order amends, extends or revokes it. Machine searches adopted after reading their coverage notes: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, citations of the order by number, edition through 2026-10-09, no hit), current-law:ecfr (eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk, citations by number, no hit) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes for 1937 onward plus operative sentences of saved order texts).

savings.reason: The order has no savings, pending-matter or continuing-effect wording. Inspections made while it was in force were completed acts; the conditions it refers to are in a Treasury decision, a separate instrument, and nothing in the order keeps it operative after January 3, 1955.
